description.en: A flattened fruit has a broad surrounding wing, apical notch and narrow retained stalk.
description.zh: 扁果具有宽环翅、顶端缺口及保留细柄。

scientific_scope.en: Fossil-specimen concept for Pteleoidea, limited to the preserved organ or thallus described here; no complete parent organism is implied.
scientific_scope.zh: Pteleoidea 的化石标本概念，仅限本文所述保存器官或叶状体，不暗示已知完整母体。

distinctness.en: Continuous symmetrical wing and apical notch differ from paired Palaeocarpinus bracts and Dillhoffia's funnel calyx.
distinctness.zh: 连续对称果翅及顶缺口区别于Palaeocarpinus成对苞片及Dillhoffia漏斗萼。

modeling_brief.en: Use a thin faceted wing around a raised seed-body area, preserving the notch and pedicel; avoid modern fruit colour claims.
modeling_brief.zh: 用薄折面翅围绕隆起籽体区，保留缺口和果柄，不主张现代果色。

uncertainty: Fruit morphotaxon; parent plant and precise affinity require the taxonomic paper.
reference_notes: Planning record only. Source access labels distinguish opened pages from indexed abstracts/excerpts. Reference-ready is not a released model or a completed dimensional/rights audit.

sources.title: Winged fruits of Pteleoidea from the Paleocene
sources.supports: Winged fruit with apical notch, style and retained pedicel.
